header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: Head of Marketing | Demand Generation & Revenue-Linked GTM

notes.music: This was the first part of my career. Put a lot of work into it!
notes.elixr_head: This is a fractional, contract role. ELIXR is a not for profit. At any given time I managed 4 devs across two projects at once. ELIXR's focus is rapid prototyping to help industry and post-secondary quicky validate XR use cases.
notes.nait: We worked with the NAIT team to define a prototype for teaching nurses to communicate in SBAR format. This was built in Unity, using a Next.JS server to process voice input through Groq. I designed the project architecture around the client requirements, managed the project, coordinated the user testing and iteration, and led the team in creating a thorough SOP/Documentation and handoff package.
notes.chinatown: This was build in Snap Lens Studio, with a Next.JS/React web app. I managed product design, project management, testing/iteration coordination and client training/handoff.
notes.ap: This was a personal project, and is currently pre revenue.
notes.vrcore: Preferred framing (Brayden's own): VRCORE Education is a VR EdTech startup where he was Fractional Marketing & Brand Lead, marketing/GTM, NOT product or development. Led go-to-market strategy, helping take the team from concept to a successful seed raise (~$1.2M valuation) in 6 months. Did brand design and web presence, built a customer-interview system, wrote a core messaging document, set up the CRM, and trained junior sales staff on the outbound sales motion. His branding and messaging work went on to be used in the partnership with the International Space Station Laboratory. Frame as contribution ('helping take', 'went on to be used'), not sole ownership. Use the name 'International Space Station Laboratory'.
